name: Atlas Node 22 compatibility
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  atlas-node22:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/atlas/phase2a-deployment-safety'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Assert Node 22
        run: node -e "if (process.versions.node.split('.')[0] !== '22') process.exit(1); console.log(process.version)"
      - name: Run only Atlas under inherited kernel network denial
        run: python3 tests/atlas/run-offline.py --node "$(command -v node)" --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/atlas-node22"
      - name: Show focused test results
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/atlas-node22/atlas-tests.stdout.txt" ]; then
            cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/atlas-node22/atlas-tests.stdout.txt"
          fi

# Simple workflow for deploying static content to GitHub Pages
name: Deploy static content to Pages

on:
  # Runs on pushes targeting the default branch
  push:
    branches: ["main"]

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:
  # Public SEO snapshots refresh every 15 minutes. Browser stock/store checks
  # and authoritative checkout remain live; scheduled notices refresh in-browser.
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/15 * * * *'

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow only one concurrent deployment, skipping runs queued between the run in-progress and latest queued.
# However, do NOT cancel in-progress runs as we want to allow these production deployments to complete.
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Single deploy job since we're just deploying
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - name: Install build dependencies
        if: github.event_name != 'push' || (!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[static-only]') && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[cms-only]'))
        run: npm ci
      # Static-only milestones use committed snapshots without backend egress.
      - name: Generate public product pages from Supabase
        if: github.event_name != 'push' || (!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[static-only]') && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[cms-only]'))
        run: node scripts/generate-product-pages.mjs
      - name: Generate public News and Operations presentation
        if: github.event_name != 'push' || (!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[static-only]') && !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[cms-only]'))
        run: node scripts/generate-site-operations.mjs
      - name: Generate CMS published articles
        run: node scripts/generate-hub-cms.mjs
      - name: Prepare Search Console verification
        env:
          GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION: ${{ vars.GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION }}
        run: node scripts/prepare-search-verification.mjs dist
      - name: Stamp first-party static asset URLs
        run: node scripts/stamp-static-assets.mjs dist
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          # Upload entire repository
          path: './dist'
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5

  workflow_dispatch:

  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow only one concurrent deployment, skipping runs queued between the run in-progress and latest queued.
# However, do NOT cancel in-progress runs as we want to allow these production deployments to complete.
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Single deploy job since we're just deploying
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          # Upload entire repository
          path: './dist'
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
